shell.reason: The consumer shell owns app navigation while this child route owns its screen scaffold and back action.

topBar.reason: The participant-only invitation route owns compact title and explicit back chrome.

stateController.notes: The route watches one participant-readable invitation, its optional participant-readable companion hold, sanitized peer profile, and event; it maps missing/error/loading branches before rendering and delegates lifecycle mutations plus canonical hold checkout to CrossPathsInvitationController.

designRefs.notes: Approved invitation, plan, consent, capacity, and entity-material contract.

states.source: Invitation, peer profile, and event provider waves render bounded loading UI.
states.nextAction: Add a route capture when Cross Paths is enabled for a staged cohort.

states.source: Missing invitation, missing supporting entity, signed-out identity, or a non-participant viewer fails closed through CatchErrorState.
states.nextAction: Keep participant-only rules and route error copy aligned.

states.source: Incoming pending invitations expose accept and decline; outgoing pending invitations expose cancel.
states.nextAction: Capture incoming and outgoing states during staged rollout.

states.source: Accepted invitation exposes the temporary event plan and an explicit cancel-plan inverse without creating dating-match UI.
states.nextAction: Capture accepted and expired plan states during staged rollout.

states.source: An accepted invitation with an active companion hold clearly says held, not booked; only the requester can complete canonical checkout while the confirmed attendee sees a waiting state.
states.nextAction: Capture the active requester and confirmed-attendee states during the organizer pilot.

states.source: Expired, cancelled, invalidated, or otherwise inactive holds disable checkout and return the viewer to current Event Detail availability.
states.nextAction: Keep terminal hold copy generic across expiry, safety, and event-unavailability release reasons.

states.source: Declined, cancelled, expired, and invalidated invitations remain truthful read-only receipts with no illegal action.
states.nextAction: Keep terminal reason copy generic enough not to reveal safety or competing-plan state.

composition.currentLayout: CrossPathsInvitationScreen composes canonical person Polaroid, adjacent event context, invitation/hold/plan actions, an explicit held-not-booked panel, and route-level loading/error/unavailable states.
composition.targetLayout: Keep person, event, and event-plan meanings visually distinct while preserving participant privacy and callable-only mutations.

sections.name: Cross Paths invitation detail
sections.migration: Implemented with provider reads at the route boundary and typed callable mutations in CrossPathsInvitationController.
